					# Total Defeat - lose 75% support equipment (150), lose 7 tanks
					add_manpower = 500
					add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
						type = support_equipment
						amount = 50
					}
					add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
						type = medium_tank_chassis
						amount = 3
					}
					add_political_power = -200
					FROM = {
						set_state_flag = wif_demilitarized_state
						set_demilitarized_zone = yes
						# Escalate straight to quintupled from whatever tier is present (or none), duration refreshed
						if = {
							limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_large_belarusian_resistance } }
							remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_large_belarusian_resistance }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_large_belarusian_resistance_doubled } }
							remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_large_belarusian_resistance_doubled }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_large_belarusian_resistance_quintupled } }
							remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_large_belarusian_resistance_quintupled }
						}
						add_dynamic_modifier = {
							modifier = wif_large_belarusian_resistance_quintupled
							days = 180
						}
					}
					set_country_flag = { flag = wif_mech_early_100 value = 1 }
					# Remove demilitarization from THIS state only, after 60 days
					FROM = {
						state_event = { id = wif_rko.31 days = 60 }
					}
					country_event = { id = wif_rko.30 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
